paper.title: PhysDreamer
paper.data: static 3D objects, video-diffusion dynamics priors, material-field estimates, and interaction examples for elastic objects
paper.method: distills video generation priors into a physical material field and uses physics simulation to synthesize action-conditioned object dynamics
paper.task: make static 3D objects respond to external forces or manipulation in physically plausible ways
paper.novelty: uses video-generation dynamics priors to estimate material behavior for interactive 3D object simulation
paper.project_relevance: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

paper.title: Feature Splatting
paper.data: 3D Gaussian scenes with distilled foundation-model features, text-grounded decomposition, material queries, and physics-simulation examples
paper.method: feature-bearing 3D Gaussians plus text-query segmentation and particle-based physics simulation with automatically assigned material properties
paper.task: language-driven physics-based scene synthesis, editing, and material-aware simulation
paper.novelty: turns 3DGS from a visual representation into a semantic/material/physics-aware editing and simulation substrate
paper.project_relevance: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

paper.title: Holodeck
paper.data: language prompts, Objaverse assets, AI2-THOR environments, human evaluations, and NoveltyTHOR navigation benchmark
paper.method: LLM-driven environment generation with spatial relational constraints, asset retrieval, layout optimization, and AI2-THOR integration
paper.task: generate customized 3D embodied AI environments from natural language
paper.novelty: uses LLM commonsense plus constraint optimization to generate diverse interactive AI2-THOR environments from open-ended prompts
paper.project_relevance: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

paper.title: Infinigen Indoors
paper.data: fully procedural indoor scenes, furniture, architecture elements, appliances, and dense synthetic labels from Blender
paper.method: procedural indoor asset and layout generation with a constraint DSL and solver for scene composition
paper.task: generate photorealistic indoor scenes and annotations for vision/embodied research
paper.novelty: extends Infinigen from natural worlds to indoor procedural scenes with real geometry and controllable annotations
paper.project_relevance: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

paper.title: OpenEQA
paper.data: embodied question-answering benchmark over physical/scanned environments
paper.method: open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark and LLM-Match answer evaluation protocol
paper.task: answer natural-language questions about an embodied environment
paper.novelty: modern open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark for evaluating environment understanding
paper.project_relevance: downstream benchmark for testing whether generated interactive environments preserve object identity, spatial relations, and semantic affordances

paper.title: PhysX-Anything
paper.data: PhysX-Mobility with 2K+ common objects plus in-the-wild single-image inputs and physical/articulation annotations
paper.method: VLM-based physical 3D generative model with efficient geometry tokenization and explicit geometry, articulation, and physical attributes
paper.task: generate simulation-ready physical 3D assets from a single image
paper.novelty: turns image-conditioned 3D generation into sim-ready assets with physical and articulation metadata
paper.project_relevance: Strong object-level source for PhysicalProperty, KinematicJoint, AssetToSimulator, and contact-rich policy-learning validation.

paper.title: SimuScene
paper.data: single-image compositional 3D scene reconstruction benchmarks plus humanoid and robot-arm downstream deployments
paper.method: physics-in-the-loop compositional reconstruction that converts simulation failures into shape/layout correction signals
paper.task: reconstruct stable simulation-ready 3D scenes from one image
paper.novelty: uses physics simulation as a diagnostic measurement tool during generation rather than only post-hoc cleanup
paper.project_relevance: Relevant to SceneTree, SupportRelation, PhysicalViolation, and simulator-ready reconstruction validators.

paper.title: REST3D
paper.data: synthetic and real-world single-RGB-image reconstruction datasets, Isaac Gym simulation checks, and VR interaction demos
paper.method: agentic physical scene understanding, scene-tree construction, image-to-3D initialization, and physics-constrained refinement
paper.task: reconstruct physically stable interactive 3D scenes from a single RGB image
paper.novelty: uses gravity-support scene trees as structural priors for stable scene reconstruction
paper.project_relevance: Provides a useful template for SceneTree, SupportGraph, StabilityCheck, and PhysicsRefinement stages.

paper.title: TriSplat
paper.data: RealEstate10K, DL3DV, ScanNet-style sparse-view reconstruction evaluations
paper.method: feed-forward oriented-triangle splatting network that predicts point maps, triangle attributes, camera poses, and mesh-ready surfaces
paper.task: reconstruct simulation-ready mesh scenes from sparse or pose-free images
paper.novelty: replaces Gaussian primitives with oriented triangle primitives that can be ingested by physics/rendering pipelines without post-hoc meshing
paper.project_relevance: Useful representation reference for MeshScene, CollisionSurface, and feed-forward sim-ready reconstruction.

paper.title: SceneSmith
paper.data: text-prompted indoor scenes, generated static assets, retrieved articulated objects, physical properties, and example scene dataset
paper.method: hierarchical agentic text-to-scene framework with designer, critic, and orchestrator VLM agents across layout, furniture, and object-population stages
paper.task: generate dense simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts
paper.novelty: combines agentic generation with physical property estimation and policy-evaluation-ready scene export
paper.project_relevance: Top PCG baseline for PromptToScene, CriticLoop, ObjectPopulation, PhysicalProperty, and policy evaluation.

paper.title: SceneFoundry
paper.data: apartment-scale generated 3D worlds with articulated assets from large-scale repositories
paper.method: language-guided diffusion with LLM floor-plan control, posterior sampling for object population, articulation-collision and walkability guidance
paper.task: generate large-scale interactive and physically usable indoor 3D worlds
paper.novelty: focuses on functionally articulated furniture and apartment-scale interactive world generation
paper.project_relevance: Relevant PCG line for LayoutConstraint, ArticulationConstraint, WalkableSpace, and infinite-world expansion.

paper.title: HY-World 2.0
paper.data: text, single-view, multi-view, and video inputs; generated 3DGS/mesh worlds; released model weights and code
paper.method: four-stage world pipeline with panorama generation, trajectory planning, world expansion, reconstruction, and WorldLens rendering
paper.task: reconstruct, generate, and simulate navigable 3D worlds from multimodal inputs
paper.novelty: unifies generation and reconstruction for explorable 3D worlds with open weights/code
paper.project_relevance: Strong open-source world-generation baseline for WorldRepresentation, TrajectoryPlan, 3DGSScene, MeshExport, and engine integration.

paper.title: SpatialStack
paper.data: multiple 3D spatial reasoning benchmarks and VLM-SpatialStack training/evaluation data
paper.method: layered geometry-language fusion that injects multi-level geometric features into a VLM hierarchy
paper.task: 3D spatial reasoning for embodied and physical AI systems
paper.novelty: moves beyond late-stage geometry fusion by stacking hierarchical geometric signals through the language backbone
paper.project_relevance: Good spatial encoder/validator reference for local geometry, global context, and relation checking in generated worlds.

paper.title: GR00T N1
paper.data: large mixed humanoid/robot datasets plus simulation benchmark evaluations and released model artifacts
paper.method: open foundation model for humanoid robots with reasoning and action components trained on diverse robot data
paper.task: generalist humanoid robot control under language and visual instructions
paper.novelty: one of the first open humanoid foundation models with official weights and reproducible release path
paper.project_relevance: Important VLA baseline for humanoid embodiments and synthetic-data-to-policy evaluation.

paper.title: Green-VLA
paper.data: 3000 hours of demonstrations, Simpler BRIDGE WidowX, CALVIN ABC-D, and real-robot evaluations
paper.method: five-stage VLA curriculum with multimodal grounding, multi-embodiment pretraining, embodiment adaptation, and RL policy alignment
paper.task: generalist robot control across humanoids, mobile manipulators, and fixed-base arms
paper.novelty: combines staged training, embodiment-aware actions, OOD detection, and RL alignment for real deployment
paper.project_relevance: Useful systems reference for staged VLA training and safety-aware execution.

paper.title: XR-1
paper.data: large-scale cross-embodiment robot datasets plus more than 14,000 rollouts on six robot embodiments and 120+ tasks
paper.method: Unified Vision-Motion Codes learned by dual-branch VQ-VAE with three-stage VLA training
paper.task: versatile robot manipulation across diverse embodiments and environments
paper.novelty: aligns visual dynamics and robot motion into a shared intermediate code for scalable VLA learning
paper.project_relevance: Strong VLA reference for cross-embodiment action representation and real rollout quality.

paper.title: TwinVLA
paper.data: single-arm public robot data plus bimanual real-world and simulation task evaluations
paper.method: modular composition of two pretrained single-arm VLA policies into a coordinated bimanual policy
paper.task: data-efficient bimanual manipulation from vision-language instructions
paper.novelty: reuses single-arm data and policies instead of requiring full bimanual pretraining
paper.project_relevance: Good baseline for bimanual task generation and policy-evaluation suites.

paper.title: MMaDA-VLA
paper.data: simulation benchmarks and real-world robot tasks including LIBERO and CALVIN-style evaluations
paper.method: native discrete diffusion VLA that jointly denoises language, images, future observations, and action chunks
paper.task: language-conditioned robot manipulation with parallel action and future-observation generation
paper.novelty: unifies multimodal instruction understanding, future visual generation, and action prediction in one diffusion backbone
paper.project_relevance: Relevant to world-action interfaces because it predicts future visual outcomes and actions jointly.

paper.title: WorldArena
paper.data: public benchmark, leaderboard, dataset, and challenge for embodied world models
paper.method: perception and functional-utility benchmark with 16 numerical video metrics, task-functionality evaluation, human judgment, and EWMScore
paper.task: evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, synthetic data engines, policy evaluators, and action planners
paper.novelty: ties world-model evaluation to functional embodied utility rather than video quality alone
paper.project_relevance: Important evaluation target for our interactive embodied world generator and world-model branches.

paper.title: World-in-World
paper.data: closed-loop world-model benchmark tasks, unified action API, code, leaderboard, and demos
paper.method: closed-loop evaluation platform where planners propose actions and world models predict future observations inside task loops
paper.task: evaluate visual world models by embodied utility in closed-loop interaction
paper.novelty: evaluates world models under recursive agent-world interaction rather than one-step visual prediction
paper.project_relevance: Provides a harness template for action-conditioned rollout evaluation and closed-loop generated-world testing.

paper.title: Ctrl-World
paper.data: policy-in-the-loop rollouts and real-world/world-model comparisons for generalist robot policies
paper.method: controllable world-model evaluation designed to let generalist robot policies roll out actions inside imagination space
paper.task: evaluate whether world models support policy-in-the-loop manipulation rollouts
paper.novelty: centers evaluation on policy utility and rollout control rather than passive generation quality
paper.project_relevance: Useful benchmark design for world-action model validators and imagined rollout tests.
